questions.text_english:
Arrange the following in chronological order and choose the correct option:
I. Gandhi-Irwin Pact
II. Rowlatt Act
III. Poona Pact
IV. Khilafat Movement
questions.solution: The correct chronological order is Option C: II, IV, I and III. The Rowlatt Act was passed in 1919, the Khilafat Movement began in 1920, the Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed in 1931, and the Poona Pact was signed in 1932. Options A, B, and D place these events in incorrect historical sequences.

Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): The Indian subcontinent was a crucial point in 'Indian Ocean trade flows' during sixteenth century.
Reason (R): Its geographical location connected East-West Asia and Europe.

questions.solution: The correct answer is Option A. The Assertion is true because the Indian subcontinent was indeed a vital hub in the Indian Ocean trade network during the sixteenth century. sub_questions.text_english: How had globalization begun long before sixteenth century? Explain.

key_points: Ancient trade routes connected continents long before the 16th century
Silk Route linked China, India, Persia, and Europe
Movement of goods, people, and ideas across regions

sub_questions.solution: Globalization had begun long before the sixteenth century through ancient trade networks. The Silk Route connected China, Central Asia, Persia, and Europe, facilitating trade in silk, spices, and precious goods. Indian merchants traded with Southeast Asia and the Arab world. The movement of people, goods, religions, and ideas across continents laid the foundation of early globalization well before the modern era.

sub_questions.text_english: How did trade help to spread diseases during the pre-modern world? Explain.

key_points: Trade routes connected distant lands and allowed diseases to spread
Merchants and sailors carried germs from one region to another
Smallpox and plague spread rapidly along trade routes

sub_questions.solution: In the pre-modern world, trade routes became pathways for the spread of diseases. Merchants, sailors, and travelers carried germs unknowingly from one region to another. When Europeans reached the Americas, they brought diseases like smallpox to which the native population had no immunity. Similarly, the bubonic plague spread from Central Asia to Europe along trade routes, causing massive death and social disruption.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the role of Johann Gutenberg in the spread of print culture in Europe.

key_points: Gutenberg invented the printing press with movable type around 1448
He printed the Bible which made books affordable and widely available
This democratized knowledge and contributed to the spread of literacy

sub_questions.solution: Johann Gutenberg invented the printing press with movable type around 1448, which revolutionized the spread of print culture in Europe. He printed the first mechanically produced Bible, making books cheaper and more accessible. Before this, manuscripts were hand-copied and available only to the elite. Gutenberg's press enabled mass production of books, spreading literacy, new ideas, and knowledge across Europe rapidly.

key_points: Martin Luther used print to spread his 95 Theses criticizing the Catholic Church
Pamphlets and printed books spread Protestant ideas rapidly across Europe

sub_questions.solution: Print played a crucial role in the expansion of the Protestant Reformation. Martin Luther used the printing press to circulate his 95 Theses criticizing the Catholic Church's corrupt practices. His ideas spread rapidly through printed pamphlets and books. The Bible was translated into vernacular languages, allowing common people to read it directly. This weakened the Church's monopoly over religious interpretation and fueled the Reformation movement across Europe.

questions.text_english:
(A) 'The formation of the British Nation-State was different from the rest of Europe.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.
OR
(B) 'Ideas of national unity in the early nineteenth century Europe were closely allied to the ideology of liberalism.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

sub_questions.text: 'ब्रिटिश राष्ट्र-राज्य का गठन शेष यूरोप से अलग था।' उपयुक्त तर्कों सहित इस कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।
sub_questions.text_english: 'The formation of the British Nation-State was different from the rest of Europe.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Britain was not formed by revolution but by gradual political integration
English Parliament gained power from the monarchy over time
Act of Union 1707 merged England and Scotland
Ireland was suppressed and incorporated after the rebellion of 1798
British identity was built by suppressing distinct cultures of Welsh, Scots, and Irish

sub_questions.solution: The formation of the British Nation-State was unique compared to the rest of Europe because it was not a result of a sudden revolution or the will of a unified people. In most of Europe, nationalism arose as a mass movement overthrowing old monarchies. In Britain, however, the nation was formed gradually through parliamentary consolidation. The English Parliament grew in power over the monarchy after a prolonged conflict in the seventeenth century. The Act of Union in 1707 brought England and Scotland together, forming Great Britain. Ireland, which had rebelled in 1798 with French support, was forcibly suppressed and incorporated into the United Kingdom in 1801. The British national identity was then constructed, but it came at the cost of suppressing the distinct cultural identities of the Welsh, Scottish, and Irish peoples. Thus, British nationalism was imposed from above rather than arising from below.

sub_questions.text: 'यूरोप में उन्नीसवीं सदी के शुरुआती दशकों में राष्ट्रीय एकता से संबंधित विचार उदारवाद से करीब से जुड़े थे।' उपयुक्त तर्कों सहित इस कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।
sub_questions.text_english: 'Ideas of national unity in the early nineteenth century Europe were closely allied to the ideology of liberalism.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Liberalism emphasized freedom of the individual and government by consent
Liberals demanded a unified national state with a constitution
Frankfurt Parliament of 1848 showed liberal-nationalist link
Liberals opposed autocracy and aristocratic privilege
They demanded freedom of press, equality before law, and representative government

sub_questions.solution: In the early nineteenth century, the ideas of national unity and liberalism were deeply intertwined in Europe. Liberalism, derived from the Latin word 'liber' meaning free, stood for individual freedom, government by consent of the governed, and equality before the law. For the liberal nationalists, the nation-state represented freedom from autocratic rule and foreign domination. They demanded a unified national government with a written constitution. The Frankfurt Parliament of 1848 brought together liberal nationalist representatives who drafted a constitution for a German nation. Liberals opposed feudal privileges, demanded freedom of the press, and wanted elected representative bodies. Thus, nationalism was seen as a movement for both political freedom and national self-determination, making it inseparable from liberalism in this period.

questions.text:
दिए गए स्रोत को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए:

'क्रांति की इस पूजा-वेदी पर हम अपना यौवन नैवेद्य के रूप में लाए हैं'

बहुत सारे राष्ट्रवादियों को लगता था कि अंग्रेजों के खिलाफ संघर्ष अहिंसा के ज़रिए पूरा नहीं हो सकता। सन् 1928 में दिल्ली स्थित फिरोजशाह कोटला मैदान में हुई बैठक में हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन आर्मी (एच.एस.आर.ए.) की स्थापना की गई। इसके नेताओं में भगत सिंह, जतिन दास और अजय घोष शामिल थे। देश के विभिन्न भागों में कार्रवाइयाँ करते हुए एच.एस.आर.ए. ने ब्रिटिश सत्ता के कई प्रतीकों को निशाना बनाया। अप्रैल 1929 में भगत सिंह और बटुकेश्वर दत्त ने लेजिस्लेटिव असेंबली में बम फेंका। उसी साल उस ट्रेन को उड़ाने का प्रयास किया गया जिसमें लॉर्ड इरविन यात्रा कर रहे थे। जिस समय भगत सिंह पर मुकदमा चला और उन्हें फाँसी दी गई उस समय उनकी उम्र केवल 23 साल थी। अपने मुकदमे के दौरान भगत सिंह ने कहा था कि वे 'बम और पिस्तौल की उपासना नहीं करते' बल्कि समाज में क्रांति चाहते हैं–

'क्रांति मानवजाति का जन्मजात अधिकार है जिसका अपहरण नहीं किया जा सकता। स्वतंत्रता प्रत्येक मनुष्य का जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है। श्रमिक वर्ग ही समाज का वास्तविक पोषक है, जनता की सर्वोपरि सत्ता की स्थापना श्रमिक वर्ग का अंतिम लक्ष्य है। इन आदर्शों के लिए और इस विश्वास के लिए हमें जो भी दंड दिया जाएगा, हम उसका सहर्ष स्वागत करेंगे। क्रांति की इस पूजा-वेदी पर हम अपना यौवन नैवेद्य के रूप में लाए हैं, क्योंकि ऐसे महान् आदर्श के लिए बड़े-से-बड़ा त्याग भी कम है। हम संतुष्ट हैं और क्रांति के आगमन की उत्सुकतापूर्वक प्रतीक्षा कर रहे हैं। इंकलाब जिंदाबाद!'
questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow:

'To the altar of this revolution we have brought our youth as incense'

Many nationalists thought that the struggle against the British could not be won through non-violence. In the year 1928, the Hindustan Socialist Republican Army (HSRA) was founded at a meeting in Ferozeshah Kotla ground in Delhi. Amongst its leaders were Bhagat Singh, Jatin Das and Ajoy Ghosh. In a series of dramatic actions in different parts of India, the HSRA targeted some of the symbols of British power. In April 1929, Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutta threw a bomb in the Legislative Assembly. In the same year there was an attempt to blow up the train that Lord Irwin was travelling in. Bhagat Singh was 23 when he was tried and executed by the colonial government. During his trial, Bhagat Singh stated that he did not wish to glorify 'the cult of the bomb and pistol' but wanted a revolution in society –

'Revolution is the inalienable right of mankind. Freedom is the imprescriptible birthright of all. The labourer is the real sustainer of society. To the altar of this revolution we have brought our youth as incense, for no sacrifice is too great for so magnificent a cause. We are content. We await the advent of revolution. Inquilab Zindabad!'

sub_questions.text: 'हिन्दुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन आर्मी' का गठन भारत के स्वतंत्रता संग्राम में एक महत्त्वपूर्ण मोड़ क्यों माना जाता है?
sub_questions.text_english: Why is the formation of 'Hindustan Socialist Republican Army (HSRA)' considered as a turning point in the freedom struggle of India?

key_points: HSRA represented an armed revolutionary approach as an alternative to non-violent struggle
It challenged British power directly through bold acts and inspired the youth

sub_questions.solution: The formation of the HSRA was a turning point because it represented a shift from non-violent resistance to an armed revolutionary approach. It showed that many nationalists believed violent resistance was necessary to end British rule, inspiring a new generation of youth to take bolder action against colonial power.

sub_questions.text: भगत सिंह के मुकदमे के भाषणों ने उन्हें एक क्रांतिकारी से स्वतंत्रता के दार्शनिक में कैसे बदल दिया?
sub_questions.text_english: How did Bhagat Singh's trial speeches transform him from a revolutionary to a philosopher of freedom?

key_points: His speeches showed he did not glorify violence but wanted social revolution
He articulated ideas of freedom, workers' rights, and human dignity

sub_questions.solution: During his trial, Bhagat Singh clarified that he did not worship the bomb and pistol but sought a revolution in society. His speeches articulated deep ideas about freedom as a birthright, the rights of the labouring class, and the need for social transformation. This intellectual depth transformed his image from a militant to a philosopher of freedom.

sub_questions.text: भगत सिंह ने अपनी पीढ़ी के लिए 'क्रांति' के अर्थ को किस प्रकार पुनपर्रिभाषित किया? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In what way did Bhagat Singh redefine the meaning of 'revolution' for his generation? Explain.

key_points: Revolution was not just about using bombs and guns
It meant establishing the supremacy of the working class and ensuring social equality
Revolution was an inalienable right of mankind aimed at social transformation

sub_questions.solution: Bhagat Singh redefined revolution for his generation by moving beyond its conventional meaning of violent uprising. He declared revolution as the inalienable right of mankind — not a celebration of violence but a call for social transformation. He emphasized that freedom was the birthright of every person, that workers were the real sustainers of society, and that the ultimate goal of revolution was to establish the supremacy of the people. Revolution, in his view, meant building a just society, not merely overthrowing British rule.

questions.text:
दिए गए भारत के राजनीतिक रेखा-मानचित्र में दो स्थानों को (A) और (B) के रूप में अंकित किया गया है। निम्नलिखित जानकारी की सहायता से उन्हें पहचानिए और उनके सही नाम समीप खींची गई रेखाओं पर लिखिए:
(A) वह स्थान जहाँ जनरल डायर ने 13 अप्रैल, 1919 को एक शांतिपूर्ण सभा पर गोली चलाने के आदेश दिए थे।
(B) वह स्थान जहाँ सन् 1927 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय काँग्रेस का अधिवेशन हुआ था।
questions.text_english:
Two places (A) and (B) have been marked on the given political outline map of India. Identify them based on the information given below and write their correct names on the lines marked on the map near them:
(A) The place where General Dyer ordered firing upon a peaceful gathering on 13 April, 1919.
(B) The place where the Session of Indian National Congress was held in the year 1927.

sub_questions.text: वह स्थान जहाँ जनरल डायर ने 13 अप्रैल, 1919 को एक शांतिपूर्ण सभा पर गोली चलाने के आदेश दिए थे।
sub_questions.text_english: The place where General Dyer ordered firing upon a peaceful gathering on 13 April, 1919.

key_points: Amritsar (Jallianwala Bagh)

sub_questions.solution: The place is Amritsar, Punjab. General Dyer ordered firing at Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar on 13 April 1919 on a peaceful gathering, killing hundreds of unarmed civilians. This incident deeply shocked the nation and intensified the freedom movement.

sub_questions.text: वह स्थान जहाँ सन् 1927 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय काँग्रेस का अधिवेशन हुआ था।
sub_questions.text_english: The place where the Session of Indian National Congress was held in the year 1927.

key_points: Madras (Chennai)

sub_questions.solution: The place is Madras (present-day Chennai). The Indian National Congress Session of 1927 was held in Madras, where the complete independence (Purna Swaraj) resolution was first mooted.

questions.solution: Place A is Amritsar (Jallianwala Bagh) where the firing on peaceful gathering took place on 13 April 1919. Place B is Madras (Chennai) where the 1927 INC Session was held.
questions.solution_hindi: स्थान A अमृतसर (जलियाँवाला बाग) है जहाँ 13 अप्रैल 1919 को गोलीबारी हुई थी। स्थान B मद्रास (चेन्नई) है जहाँ 1927 में INC का अधिवेशन हुआ था।

questions.text:
प्रवाह चार्ट को पूरा करने के लिए दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही मृदा की पहचान कीजिए:
भारी वर्षा + उच्च निक्षालन → ? → चाय और कॉफी उगाने के लिए उपयोगी
questions.text_english:
Identify the correct soil from the given options to complete the flow chart:
Heavy Rainfall + High Leaching → ? → Useful for growing Coffee and Tea
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option B — Laterite soil. Laterite soil is formed under conditions of heavy rainfall and high leaching, which washes away silica and leaves iron and aluminium oxides behind. This soil is acidic in nature and is well-suited for growing plantation crops like coffee and tea, especially in the hilly regions of Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प B — लैटेराइट मृदा है। यह मृदा भारी वर्षा और उच्च निक्षालन से बनती है और चाय व कॉफी उगाने के लिए उपयुक्त है।

questions.text: चिपको आंदोलन से संबंधित राज्य की पहचान कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Identify the state related with the Chipko Movement:
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option C — Uttarakhand. The Chipko Movement originated in the Chamoli district of Uttarakhand (then part of Uttar Pradesh) in 1973. Villagers, especially women, hugged trees to prevent them from being cut by commercial contractors. This movement became a landmark environmental conservation effort in India.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C — उत्तराखंड है। चिपको आंदोलन 1973 में चमोली, उत्तराखंड में शुरू हुआ था।

I. प्रारंभिक जीविका निर्वाह कृषि | (a) आधुनिक निवेशों के साथ कम श्रमिकों का उपयोग

questions.text_english:
Match Column-I with Column-II and choose the correct option:
Column-I (Types of Farming) | Column-II (Features)
I. Primitive subsistence farming | (a) Use of modern inputs with less labour
II. Intensive subsistence farming | (b) Single crop cultivation on large scale
III. Commercial farming | (c) Slash and burn cultivation
IV. Plantation farming | (d) Labour intensive cultivation
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option C: I-(c), II-(d), III-(a), IV-(b). Primitive subsistence farming uses slash and burn methods. Intensive subsistence farming is labour intensive. Commercial farming uses modern inputs with less labour. Plantation farming involves single crop cultivation on a large scale. These correct matches rule out Options A, B, and D.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C है: I-(c), II-(d), III-(a), IV-(b)।

questions.text:
रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
खनिज → लौह धातु (निकल), ? (बॉक्साइट), बहुमूल्य खनिज (सोना)
questions.text_english:
Choose the appropriate option to fill in the blank:
Minerals → Ferrous (Nickel), ? (Bauxite), Precious (Gold)
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option C — Non-Ferrous Minerals. Minerals are classified into ferrous (containing iron, e.g., nickel), non-ferrous (metallic but not containing iron, e.g., bauxite, copper), and precious minerals (e.g., gold, silver). Bauxite is a non-ferrous metallic mineral used to produce aluminium, which fits perfectly in the blank category.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C — अलौह खनिज है। बॉक्साइट एक अलौह धातु खनिज है।

questions.text: भारत में भू-उपयोग को निर्धारित करने वाले तत्त्वों से संबंधित सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Choose the correct option related to the factors that determined the land use pattern in India:
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option D — Physical and Human factors. Land use patterns in India are determined by both physical factors (relief, climate, soil type, availability of water) and human factors (population density, technological capability, cultural traditions, economic development). These two broad categories together shape how land is used across the country.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प D — भौतिक और मानवीय कारक है। भूमि उपयोग को प्राकृतिक और मानवीय दोनों कारक प्रभावित करते हैं।

questions.text: बेहतर उत्पादकता और जैविक खेती के लिए कोई दो उपाय सुझाइये।
questions.text_english: Suggest any two measures for better productivity and organic farming.

key_points: Use of organic manure and compost instead of chemical fertilizers
Crop rotation to maintain soil fertility and reduce pests naturally

questions.solution: Two important measures for better productivity and organic farming are: First, the use of organic manure, compost, and bio-fertilizers instead of chemical fertilizers to maintain soil health and improve long-term productivity. Second, adopting crop rotation and intercropping practices, which naturally restore soil nutrients, reduce pest attacks, and eliminate the need for chemical pesticides, making farming sustainable and eco-friendly.
questions.solution_hindi: बेहतर उत्पादकता और जैविक खेती के लिए दो उपाय: (1) रासायनिक उर्वरकों के स्थान पर जैव उर्वरक और खाद का उपयोग। (2) फसल चक्रण अपनाना जिससे मिट्टी की उर्वरता बनी रहे।

(A) 'Energy saved is energy produced.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

(B) 'Electricity has a wide range of applications in today's world that its per capita consumption is considered as an index of development.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

sub_questions.text: 'ऊर्जा की बचत ही ऊर्जा उत्पादन है।' इस कथन को उपयुक्त तर्कों के साथ न्यायसंगत ठहराइये।
sub_questions.text_english: 'Energy saved is energy produced.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Energy resources are limited and non-renewable sources will eventually deplete
Saving energy reduces pressure on production, equivalent to producing new energy
Use of energy-efficient appliances reduces consumption
Public transport over private vehicles saves enormous energy
Conservation is key to sustainable development

sub_questions.solution: The statement 'energy saved is energy produced' is entirely justified because saving energy reduces the demand on limited resources, which is functionally equivalent to producing new energy. Most of our energy comes from non-renewable sources like coal, petroleum, and natural gas, which are finite and will eventually be exhausted. When we save energy through efficient appliances, LED lighting, and reduced wastage, we extend the life of these resources significantly. Using public transport instead of private vehicles drastically cuts fuel consumption. Switching off appliances when not in use, using solar panels, and promoting energy audits in industries all contribute to conservation. Every unit of energy saved means one less unit needs to be produced, reducing environmental pollution and carbon emissions simultaneously. Thus, energy conservation is a critical component of sustainable development.

sub_questions.text: 'आधुनिक विश्व में बिजली के अनुप्रयोग इतने ज्यादा विस्तृत हैं कि इसके प्रति व्यक्ति उपयोग को विकास का सूचकांक माना जाता है।' इस कथन को उपयुक्त तर्कों के साथ न्यायसंगत ठहराइये।
sub_questions.text_english: 'Electricity has a wide range of applications in today's world that its per capita consumption is considered as an index of development.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Electricity powers industry, agriculture, transport, and communication
Higher per capita consumption indicates greater industrialization and quality of life
Electricity access is linked to education, healthcare, and economic productivity
Developed nations have much higher electricity consumption
Lack of electricity access is associated with poverty and underdevelopment

sub_questions.solution: The statement is well justified because electricity has become the backbone of modern civilization and its consumption reflects a country's level of development. In industry, electricity powers machinery, factories, and manufacturing units. In agriculture, it runs irrigation pumps and cold storage facilities. In homes, it provides lighting, heating, cooking, and entertainment. In healthcare, it powers medical equipment, refrigerators for vaccines, and operation theatres. In education and communication, it enables computers, the internet, and digital learning. Countries with high per capita electricity consumption, like the USA, Japan, and European nations, are generally highly developed. In contrast, nations with poor electricity access face poverty and low productivity. Therefore, per capita electricity consumption is rightly considered a reliable index of development.

questions.solution: This question has two options. See sub_questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text:
दिए गए स्रोत को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए:

बाढ़

बाढ़ के समय लिए जाने वाले मूलभूत सुरक्षा उपाय:
• मौसम के ताज़ा बुलेटिन और बाढ़ की चेतावनियों के लिए रेडियो/टीवी सुनें। यह जानकारी दूसरों तक भी पहुँचाएँ।
• एक पारिवारिक आपातकालीन किट तैयार रखें, जिसमें पोर्टेबल रेडियो/ट्रांजिस्टर, टॉर्च, अतिरिक्त बैटरियाँ, प्राथमिक उपचार बक्स व आवश्यक दवाइयाँ, ओआरएस, सूखा भोजन, पीने का पानी, माचिस, मोमबत्तियाँ और अन्य ज़रूरी सामान शामिल हों।
• अपने घर में हरिकेन लैम्प, रस्सियाँ, रबड़ ट्यूब, छाता और बाँस की छड़ी रखें। ये उपयोगी हो सकते हैं।
• नकद धनराशि, गहने, कीमती सामान और महत्त्वपूर्ण दस्तावेज़ सुरक्षित स्थान पर रखें।
• बाढ़ आने की स्थिति में परिवार के सदस्यों और पशुओं के साथ सुरक्षित स्थान जैसे राहत शिविर, निकासी केन्द्र या ऊँचे मैदानों पर चले जाएँ और वहाँ शरण लें।
• घर छोड़ने से पहले बिजली और गैस कनेक्शन बंद कर दें।

बाढ़ के दौरान:
• बाढ़ के पानी में प्रवेश न करें, यह खतरनाक हो सकता है।
• बच्चों को बाढ़ के पानी में या उसके आसपास न खेलने दें।
• सीवर लाइन, नालियों, ड्रेनों और कलवर्ट्स से दूर रहें।
• साँपों से सावधान रहें, बाढ़ के समय साँप के काटने की घटनाएँ आम होती हैं।
• बिजली के खंभों और गिरी हुई तारों से दूर रहें ताकि करंट से बचा जा सके।
• गीले विद्युत उपकरणों का उपयोग न करें, उपयोग से पहले उनकी जाँच कराएँ।
• ताज़ा पका हुआ और सूखा भोजन खाएँ। भोजन को हमेशा ढककर रखें।
• उबला और छना हुआ पानी ही पिएँ।
• घर के आसपास की नालियाँ और गटर साफ रखें।
• पानी का जमाव मच्छरों और जल-जनित बीमारियों को जन्म दे सकता है। बीमार पड़ने पर तुरंत चिकित्सकीय सहायता लें।
• आसपास की सफाई और कीटाणुनाशन के लिए ब्लीचिंग पाउडर और चूने का उपयोग करें।
questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow:

FLOODS

Basic safety precautions to be taken:
• Listen to radio/TV for the latest weather bulletins and flood warnings. Pass on the information to others.
• Make a family emergency kit which should include, a portable radio/transistor, torch, spare batteries, a first aid box along with essential medicines, ORS, dry food items, drinking water, matchboxes, candles and other essential items.
• Keep hurricane lamp, ropes, rubber tubes, umbrella and bamboo stick in your house. These could be useful.
• Keep your cash, jewellery, valuables, important documents etc. in a safe place.
• If there is a flood, move along with your family members and cattle to safe areas like relief camps, evacuation centers, elevated grounds where you can take shelter.
• Turn off power and gas connections before leaving your house.

During Floods:
• Don't enter into flood waters; it could be dangerous.
• Don't allow children to play in or near flood waters.
• Stay away from sewerage line, gutters, drains, culverts etc.
• Be careful of snakes; snakebites are common during floods.
• Stay away from electric poles and fallen power-lines to avoid electrocution.
• Don't use wet electrical appliances, get them checked before use.
• Eat freshly cooked and dry food. Always keep your food covered.
• Use boiled and filtered drinking water.
• Keep all drains, gutters near your house clean.
• Stagnation of water can breed vector/water-borne diseases. In case of sickness, seek medical assistance.
• Use bleaching powder and lime to disinfect the surroundings.

sub_questions.text: बाढ़ के बाद पानी का उपयोग करने से पहले कोई एक सावधानी सुझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Suggest one precaution before using water after floods.

key_points: Use only boiled and filtered drinking water after floods

sub_questions.solution: After floods, one must use only boiled and filtered drinking water to avoid waterborne diseases such as cholera, typhoid, and diarrhoea, which can spread rapidly due to contamination of water sources during flooding.

sub_questions.text: बाढ़ के दौरान खाद्य सामग्री सुरक्षा संबंधित किन्हीं दो उपायों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Mention any two measures related to protection of food items during floods.

key_points: Eat only freshly cooked and dry food
Always keep food covered to prevent contamination

sub_questions.solution: During floods, food safety is critical. First, one should eat only freshly cooked and dry food to avoid contamination. Second, food should always be kept covered to protect it from insects, flood water, and germs that spread rapidly during floods.

sub_questions.text: बाढ़ की चेतावनी के दौरान घर से निकलने से पहले के कोई दो उपाय सुझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Suggest two actions to be taken before leaving the house during a flood warning.

key_points: Turn off electricity and gas connections before leaving
Keep valuables, important documents, cash and medicines in a safe place or take them along

sub_questions.solution: Before leaving the house during a flood warning, two important steps must be taken. First, one should turn off all electricity and gas connections to prevent accidents like short circuits or gas leaks. Second, one should secure cash, jewellery, important documents, and essential medicines either in a waterproof bag or safe location, so that critical resources are protected during evacuation.

questions.text_english: Explain any two features of federalism.

key_points: There are two or more levels of government with constitutionally defined powers
The constitution is supreme and its provisions cannot be changed unilaterally by one level of government

questions.solution: Two key features of federalism are: First, a federal system has two or more levels of government — central (national) and state (regional) — each with its own jurisdiction and powers defined by the Constitution. Second, the Constitution is supreme in a federation. Powers are clearly divided between the levels of government, and neither level can unilaterally change this division. Any amendment requires consent of both levels.
questions.solution_hindi: संघवाद की दो विशेषताएँ: (1) शासन के दो या अधिक स्तर होते हैं जिनके अधिकार संविधान द्वारा निर्धारित होते हैं। (2) संविधान सर्वोच्च होता है और किसी भी स्तर की सरकार इसे एकतरफा नहीं बदल सकती।

questions.text_english: Explain any two Constitutional provisions that make India a secular nation.

key_points: Freedom of religion — every citizen has the right to practice, profess, and propagate any religion
State has no official religion — the government does not favour or discriminate against any religion

questions.solution: Two Constitutional provisions that make India a secular nation are: First, Articles 25-28 of the Indian Constitution guarantee freedom of religion to every citizen. Any individual has the right to freely profess, practice, and propagate their chosen religion. Second, India has no official state religion. The government neither promotes nor discriminates against any religion, treating all religions equally. The state does not use public funds for religious purposes and maintains neutrality in religious matters.

key_points: Parties contest elections and form governments
Parties put forward policies and programmes for voters to choose
Parties that lose form the opposition and keep a check on the ruling party

questions.solution: Political parties perform several crucial functions in a democracy. First, they contest elections by nominating candidates. For example, in India, the BJP and INC field candidates across constituencies and the winning party forms the government. Second, parties put forward policies and programmes for voters to evaluate. For instance, parties may promise economic reforms, education policies, or healthcare schemes. Third, parties that lose elections form the opposition, which plays a vital role by criticizing government policies and holding the ruling party accountable. This system of competition ensures democratic functioning and prevents concentration of power in one hand.

sub_questions.text_english: 'The blend of accountability, responsiveness and legitimacy forms the foundation of a democratic government.' Examine the statement.

key_points: Accountability means rulers are answerable to the people
Responsiveness means government acts on people's needs and concerns
Legitimacy means government derives authority from the will of the people through elections
Together these three make democracy meaningful and durable
Without these, democracy becomes hollow and authoritarian tendencies arise

sub_questions.solution: The statement accurately captures the essence of a functioning democratic government. Accountability means that elected representatives are answerable to the citizens for their actions and decisions. In a democracy, officials who fail to perform can be voted out of power, which keeps them disciplined. Responsiveness means that the government must be sensitive to the needs, problems, and aspirations of the people it governs. A responsive government formulates policies that address public welfare in areas like health, education, and employment. Legitimacy refers to the moral and legal authority of a government that arises from the free and fair consent of the governed through elections. Without legitimacy, a government lacks public trust. Together, accountability, responsiveness, and legitimacy ensure that a democracy is both just and effective, preventing authoritarianism and keeping government in service of the people.

sub_questions.text: 'नागरिकों की गरिमा और स्वतंत्रता लोकतंत्र का सार है।' इस कथन की परख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: 'Dignity and freedom of the citizens are the essence of democracy.' Examine the statement.

key_points: Democracy recognizes the inherent dignity of every individual
It ensures equal rights regardless of caste, religion, or gender
Freedom of expression, association, and movement are guaranteed
Dignity of marginalized groups is protected through constitutional provisions
Without dignity and freedom, democracy is merely a formal procedure without substance

sub_questions.solution: The statement rightly identifies dignity and freedom as the core values of democracy. Democracy is built on the recognition that every human being has inherent worth and deserves respect. It guarantees equal rights to all citizens regardless of their caste, religion, gender, or economic status. Freedom of speech, expression, association, and movement are fundamental rights enshrined in democratic constitutions. India's Constitution, for instance, abolished untouchability and guarantees equal protection before law, upholding the dignity of historically marginalized communities. Without these freedoms, democracy becomes an empty ritual. Citizens must be empowered to live freely, think independently, and participate in governance. Dignity and freedom together give democracy its moral purpose and ensure that power is used for human welfare rather than oppression.

questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow:

POWER SHARING

Power sharing arrangements can also be seen in the way political parties, pressure groups and movements control or influence those in power. In a democracy, the citizens must have freedom to choose among various contenders for power. In contemporary democracies, this takes the form of competition among different parties. Such competition ensures that power does not remain in one hand. In the long run, power is shared among different political parties that represent different ideologies and social groups. Sometimes this kind of sharing can be direct, when two or more parties form an alliance to contest elections. If their alliance is elected, they form a coalition government and thus share power. In a democracy, we find interest groups, such as those of traders, businessmen, industrialists, farmers and industrial workers. They also will have a share in governmental power, either through participation in governmental committees or bringing influence on the decision-making process.

sub_questions.solution: Pressure groups such as trade unions, farmer organizations, and business associations influence the government by participating directly in governmental committees and by organizing protests, lobbying, and campaigns to push for policies that benefit their members. sub_questions.solution: Social groups benefit from power sharing because it ensures their interests are represented in the government. When different social groups — such as farmers, workers, or minority communities — have a share in power, the government is more likely to make policies that protect their rights and address their needs, reducing the risk of discrimination or exploitation.

key_points: Citizens vote in elections to choose representatives and governments
Citizens participate through pressure groups and movements to influence government decisions

sub_questions.solution: Citizens contribute to the power sharing process in multiple ways. First, through voting in elections, citizens choose their representatives and indirectly determine which party or coalition governs. Second, they participate through interest groups, movements, and pressure groups that push the government to respond to public demands. Third, citizens contribute by forming or joining political parties, contesting elections, expressing opinions through the media, and engaging in public debates that shape government policies. Their active participation makes democracy meaningful and ensures power serves the public good.

questions.solution: The correct answer is Option C — 82%. According to Row III of the table, the percentage of rural children aged 10-14 years attending school is 85% for males and 82% for females. The question asks specifically about female children attending school in this age group, which is clearly given as 82%.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C — 82% है। तालिका की तीसरी पंक्ति के अनुसार 10-14 वर्ष की ग्रामीण लड़कियों में स्कूल जाने का प्रतिशत 82% है।

स्वप्ना का गाँव में अपना एक खेत है। खेती के खर्चों को पूरा करने के लिए वह ऋण लेना चाहती है।
निम्नलिखित में से किस स्रोत से स्वप्ना को ऋण लेना चाहिए?
questions.text_english:
Read the following case and choose the correct option:
Swapna owns a small farm in her village. She wants to take loan to meet the expense of cultivation.
From which of the following sources should Swapna take the loan?
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option B — Nearest nationalised bank. Swapna should take a loan from a nationalised (formal) bank because formal credit sources offer lower interest rates, transparent terms, and legal protection. The Reserve Bank of India does not give direct loans to farmers. Village moneylenders and agricultural traders (informal sources) charge very high interest rates and may use unfair practices, trapping borrowers in debt. A nationalised bank also offers agricultural loan schemes like Kisan Credit Card at affordable rates.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प B है। स्वप्ना को नजदीकी राष्ट्रीयकृत बैंक से ऋण लेना चाहिए क्योंकि यह कम ब्याज दर पर कृषि ऋण देता है। साहूकार और व्यापारी अनौपचारिक स्रोत हैं जो अधिक ब्याज लेते हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से उदारीकरण का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन कौन-सा है?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following best describes liberalisation?
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option C — Removal of restrictions on trade. Liberalisation refers to the process of reducing or eliminating government-imposed restrictions on international trade and investment, allowing markets to operate more freely. It includes removing trade barriers like import duties, quotas, and licensing requirements. Options A, B, and D describe protectionist policies which are the opposite of liberalisation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C है — व्यापार पर से प्रतिबंध हटाना। उदारीकरण का अर्थ है सरकारी नियंत्रणों और प्रतिबंधों को कम करके व्यापार को स्वतंत्र बनाना।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संगठन 'मानव विकास रिपोर्ट' प्रकाशित करता है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following organisations publishes the 'Human Development Report'?
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option D — United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). The UNDP publishes the Human Development Report annually, which ranks countries based on the Human Development Index (HDI) measuring life expectancy, education, and per capita income. The WTO deals with trade, WHO with health, and UNEP with environment — none of them publish the HDR.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प D है — संयुक्त राष्ट्र विकास कार्यक्रम (UNDP)। यह मानव विकास रिपोर्ट प्रकाशित करता है जिसमें HDI के आधार पर देशों की रैंकिंग होती है।

साक्षरता दर _______ और उससे अधिक आयु के लोगों में, साक्षर जनसंख्या का अनुपात है।
questions.text_english:
Choose the correct option to fill the blank:
Literacy Rate is expressed as a proportion of the literate population in the age group _____ and above.
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option A — 7 years. In India, Literacy Rate is defined as the proportion of the population aged 7 years and above who can read and write with understanding in any language. This definition is used in the Census of India. Children below 7 years are excluded as they are considered too young to be assessed for literacy.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A — 7 वर्ष है। भारत में साक्षरता दर 7 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु की जनसंख्या में साक्षरों के अनुपात के रूप में मापी जाती है।

questions.text: 'नई प्रौद्योगिकी ने दुनिया को आपस में जुड़ने में सहायता की है।' इस कथन को उपयुक्त तर्कों द्वारा न्यायसंगत ठहराइये।
questions.text_english: 'New technology has helped the world to become connected.' Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Internet and telecommunications connect people and businesses globally
Transportation technology has reduced time and cost of moving goods
Digital platforms enable global trade, remote work, and cultural exchange

questions.solution: New technology has dramatically connected the world in multiple ways. The internet and telecommunications enable instant communication across continents, allowing businesses to coordinate globally and individuals to connect in real time. Advances in transportation — like container ships, aeroplanes, and refrigerated transport — have reduced the cost and time of moving goods, enabling global trade. Digital platforms allow companies to outsource services like IT support, data processing, and customer care to distant countries. For example, Indian software companies serve clients in the USA and Europe. These technologies together have made globalisation possible and the world a closely interconnected place.
questions.solution_hindi: नई प्रौद्योगिकी ने इंटरनेट, टेलीकॉम, परिवहन और डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म के माध्यम से दुनिया को आपस में जोड़ा है।

questions.text: ऋण की औपचारिक और अनौपचारिक साखों में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Differentiate between formal and informal sources of credit.

key_points: Formal sources include banks and cooperatives regulated by the RBI; informal sources include moneylenders, traders, and friends
Formal sources charge lower interest rates; informal sources charge very high rates
Formal sources follow transparent, legal terms; informal sources may exploit borrowers

questions.solution: Formal sources of credit include nationalized banks, cooperative banks, and regional rural banks. They are regulated by the Reserve Bank of India, charge relatively low interest rates, and follow standardized, transparent procedures. Informal sources of credit include village moneylenders, agricultural traders, employers, and friends or relatives. They are not regulated by any government authority, charge very high interest rates, and may use unfair or exploitative practices. Borrowers from informal sources often fall into debt traps. The government aims to increase the share of formal credit to protect vulnerable borrowers.
questions.solution_hindi: औपचारिक ऋण स्रोत RBI द्वारा नियंत्रित होते हैं और कम ब्याज लेते हैं। अनौपचारिक स्रोत जैसे साहूकार अधिक ब्याज लेते हैं और कोई नियमन नहीं होता।

questions.text: विकास की धारणीयता क्यों आवश्यक है? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Why is sustainable development essential? Explain with examples.

key_points: Sustainable development meets present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their needs
Natural resources are finite and must be used wisely
Examples include using renewable energy, organic farming, and conservation of water

questions.solution: Sustainable development is essential because natural resources are limited and reckless exploitation today will leave nothing for future generations. It means meeting our present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. For example, over-extraction of groundwater for irrigation can permanently deplete water tables, making farming impossible in the future. Similarly, deforestation for industry destroys biodiversity and increases climate change. By adopting sustainable practices like using solar and wind energy instead of fossil fuels, practicing organic farming, and conserving forests, we can ensure development that is both environmentally responsible and long-lasting.
questions.solution_hindi: धारणीय विकास इसलिए आवश्यक है क्योंकि प्राकृतिक संसाधन सीमित हैं। भविष्य की पीढ़ियों के लिए संसाधन बचाना जरूरी है। उदाहरण: सौर ऊर्जा का उपयोग, जल संरक्षण।

sub_questions.text_english: Describe the efforts done by the Indian government to increase employment in rural areas.

key_points: MGNREGA guarantees 100 days of wage employment to rural households
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana creates rural infrastructure and employment
Skill development programmes train rural youth for better employment
Investment in agriculture, irrigation, and rural industries creates jobs
Self-help groups and microfinance support rural entrepreneurship

sub_questions.solution: The Indian government has taken several significant steps to increase employment in rural areas. The most important is the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), which guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households engaged in unskilled manual work. This provides income security to millions of rural poor. The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana focuses on building rural roads, creating both infrastructure and employment opportunities. The government has also invested in irrigation, rural electrification, and agriculture development to support farm-based employment. Skill development initiatives train rural youth in non-farm skills to access better jobs. Self-help groups supported by microfinance enable rural women to start small businesses. National Rural Livelihood Mission also promotes sustainable livelihoods through community institutions.

sub_questions.text: भारत में तृतीयक क्षेत्रक के बढ़ते महत्त्व का वर्णन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Describe the rising importance of Tertiary Sector in India.

key_points: Tertiary sector includes services like banking, IT, transport, trade, and healthcare
It has become the largest contributor to India's GDP
IT and software services have made India globally competitive
It creates large-scale employment in urban and semi-urban areas
Growth of e-commerce, telecom, and financial services shows sector's expanding role

sub_questions.solution: The tertiary sector, which includes services such as banking, insurance, IT, transportation, trade, communication, education, and healthcare, has been rising rapidly in importance in India. It is now the largest contributor to India's GDP, accounting for more than 50% of national income. India's IT and software industry has achieved global recognition, with cities like Bengaluru and Hyderabad becoming major tech hubs serving international clients. The growth of e-commerce platforms, digital payments, telecom networks, and fintech services reflects the expanding role of services. The tertiary sector creates a large number of jobs for educated youth. Rising incomes have increased demand for services. The government's focus on Digital India, financial inclusion, and startup culture has further accelerated the growth of the tertiary sector in the country.
